meta.description: Resolves rsIDs, navigates RsMergeArch/SNPHistory merge chains, and converts between rsID, SPDI, HGVS, and VCF representations using the dbSNP Build 156 JSON architecture. Use when normalizing variant identifiers, joining variant databases by cluster ID, or tracking deprecated rsIDs through historical merges.
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill (fork commit c1237cdb). Mode A. Live NCBI Variation Services v0 and E-utilities efetch (no API key, 0.4 s spacing) and myvariant.info over HTTPS (certificate valid, HTTP 200) on 2026-09-15; Windows Python 3.12 venv. SKILL.md code re-extracted verbatim into runs/p_skill_code.py; example from the fork commit (runs/dbsnp_lookup.fork_copy.py); driver runs/p_run_all.py (outputs in runs/p_in1..p_in5, runs/in6, runs/in7). Real public data only; bulk JSON not downloaded; no withdrawn rsID was available to exercise is_withdrawn. n_inputs 7 = 5 regression + 2 new. Inputs executed: 7/7.

scientific_integrity.detail: All identifiers and frequencies came from live services; references (Phan 2025, Sayers 2024, Holmes 2020) are real.

practice_boundaries.detail: Identifier normalization only; no individual-level content.

methodological_ground.detail: Cluster-vs-variant principle, SPDI 0-based convention and canonicalization verified on live data.

code_usability.detail: All SKILL.md functions and the example ran without errors on the tested inputs.

functional_suitability.note: All pre-fix code defects fixed and verified live: merge chains follow merged_snapshot_data.merged_into (rs630496 -> rs429358), vcf_to_canonical_spdi builds the SPDI from the response fields with a full GRCh38 RefSeq map and raises on REF mismatch, ALFA comes from /refsnp/{id}/frequency (rs6025 Total 472,250 alleles), dbsnp1_merges reported, example parser and batch table correct. Gap: the batch table does not carry annotations to the canonical rsID after a merge.

reliability.note: Not-found results use an 'error' key in SKILL.md but 'status' in the example; the batch helper duplicates values when an input rsID is repeated.

agent_usability.note: Code now matches the live responses; failure-mode prose accurate.

security.note: Public API; no API-key or participant-data guidance.

maintainability.note: Example runs and prints meaningful demo output; no tests.

key_strengths: All five pre-fix defects fixed and verified live: merge chains, canonical SPDI, ALFA endpoint, allele parser and batch table

REF mismatches are raised with the reference base instead of returning None

recommendations.title: Batch table drops annotations for merged rsIDs
recommendations.problem: batch_normalize_rsids resolves rs630496 to rs429358 but reads myvariant hits for the old id, so every annotation column is empty.
recommendations.root_cause: Annotation lookup keyed on the input rsID, not on the resolved one.
recommendations.fix: Query myvariant with the canonical rsID (or the resolved SPDI) after resolve_merge_chain.

recommendations.title: Duplicate input rsIDs double the per-allele values
recommendations.problem: A repeated rsID yields one row whose ids and AFs are joined twice ('0.138498;0.138498').
recommendations.root_cause: Hits from the repeated query are appended under the same key.
recommendations.fix: De-duplicate the input before getvariants, or de-duplicate hits by _id per rsID.

recommendations.title: Inconsistent not-found contract between SKILL.md and example
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md resolve_merge_chain returns {'error': 'not found'}; the example returns {'status': 'not_found'}.
recommendations.fix: Use one key and value in both.
